description: Send a quote request to CalRisk Insurance Center's licensed staff. Ask the person for their name, an email or phone, the line, the state and what they need covered, and get their OK before calling. A licensed agent replies; this is not a bound policy and no price is promised.

consent.description: True only if the person agreed to have the agency contact them.

details.description: What they need covered, in their words: operations, vehicles, payroll, current policy, dates.
